narrative: Material PL3__M65CC083 shows erratic, high-volume demand (CV=0.68, mean 315 units/day) with a statistically significant downward trend over the analysis period. Lead times are unstable (CV=0.70, mean 1.26 days), amplifying buffer requirements. The (Q,R) policy with safety stock of 606 units and order quantity of 1,469 units (near EOQ) is recommended to achieve 95% service level while reducing annual costs from $179,166 to $7,584.
warnings: Statistically significant downward demand trend detected (slope=-0.84 units/day, p<0.0001) — recalibrate parameters quarterly.

research_insights.selection_rationale: High daily demand volume with erratic variability and unstable lead times suits a continuous-review (Q,R) model over periodic review. EOQ minimises the cost trade-off between holding and ordering. MOQ=22 is non-binding vs EOQ=1,469.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage utilisation at 40.2% (2,075 of 5,159 units). No capacity constraint binds. Robust safety stock (763 units) remains feasible within storage limits.
